name: NDI discovery server
description: Run NDI®'s own Discovery Server on this box, so that senders and receivers on a network you control find each other through it. The program is proprietary and is not part of this box: its owner puts it in place (see pvj/NDI.md). It is not a password: whatever can reach it can register with it and ask it.
